title: Hecke structure of quaternionic modular forms mod $p$
summary: We relate the systems of Hecke eigenvalues arising from the (mod $p$) modular forms on the Shimura curve attached to the indefinite quaternion algebra $B$ of discriminant $δ$ over $\mathbf{Q}$ to the systems of Hecke eigenvalues arising from the (mod $p$) algebraic modular forms attached to the definite quaternion algebra $D$ of discriminant $pδ$. Moreover, we discuss details of the Hecke structure on the latter spaces, following ideas of Serre.
